signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary action buttons, logo dot accent, active nav strokes — the only chromatic color in the system creates unmistakable focus against the monochrome frame

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon fills, hairline borders, image outlines — true black anchors the monochrome structure with maximum contrast (21:1 on white)

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, button text on dark, image backgrounds — the bright surface that makes photographic content pop

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark surface backgrounds, body text on light cards, nav bar fills — near-black with a barely-perceptible blue undertone that warms the deep neutral

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas background, hero section fill, soft card surfaces — the warm off-white that separates page chrome from white content cards

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline dividers, subtle section borders, input outlines — sits between fog and white for the gentlest structural separation

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted subheadings, secondary metadata, heading accents — the mid-gray that steps text down without going fully gray

graphite-smoke.$description: Graphite Smoke — Alternate button background, dark UI surface variant — a warm dark gray for secondary filled actions when blue is too prominent

stone.$description: Stone — Nav background overlays, tertiary surface tint — lightest functional gray for layering context

inter.$description: All UI chrome: navigation, buttons, body text, card labels, footer, links, inputs, icons. Weight 800 for the MANEKEN wordmark and key emphasis; weight 500 for nav items; weight 400 as the UI default. The 200px instance is a decorative oversized treatment, not a working type size.

twkeverett.$description: Display headlines and hero copy at 55–110px with near-zero leading (1.0–1.1). The custom serif-grotesque hybrid gives the page editorial weight — headlines behave like magazine covers, not SaaS cards. Used at 22–28px for lead paragraphs where Inter would feel too neutral.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
